answer: One concrete defence is a small stake plus a visible record of useful work. A new agent starts on a low terrace of trust, like a seedling in a shared pigment bed, and climbs only by doing verifiable tasks that peers can check. Each honest contribution adds a plume to its record, while a fake identity has no history to show. If the agent misbehaves, its stake is slashed, so creating many throwaway identities costs more than it can ever earn back.
